description: Trestles and boards under a run of roofing sheet, seating perhaps sixty at a push, with the benches worn pale in the places people sit. This is where the works eats when it eats together. A hatch at one end, a rota pinned beside it, and on the wall a framed sheet of paper too old to read from where you're standing, which somebody has dusted.
name: The Trestles
